meta.title: Dispute Task Assignment to Stakeholders: refused for a user without the AP Manager role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the AP Manager role and attempt to assign a dispute to a stakeholder.
Repeat the assignment as an AP Manager and compare availability or refusal in the same Growth-tier tenant.
Verify the tenant's Growth plan and record whether RBAC deliberately grants the action to other roles.
